svg.title: Two verification paths
svg.desc: Who supplied the contact details at each step? Path A: the same source controls the chain: Path A: suspicious SMS → support link in the SMS → callback number supplied by that support chat → “Yes, that was us.” Path B: return to an established trusted process: Path B: suspicious SMS → pause → independently open the established company help desk → verify ticket and owner → follow authorization.
